title: Statehood
description: Delaware achieved statehood 1787 (1st). The road to statehood ran through territorial government, population thresholds, and a congressional enabling act — the standard American path. First to ratify the Constitution. Statehood Day is still celebrated, and the admission order gives Delaware its number among the states.
